- Day 1: SE deep-dive + eval harness alignment (Dev)

Subject: Eval harness integration steps + canary/rollback details

Hi Jana / Miguel / Keen IT,

Following Monica's plan — below are concrete steps and a minimal checklist for the SE call. I’ve attached the eval_harness_integration_guide.pdf with commands and examples.

High-level approach:
1) Deployment mode: we recommend running the Redwood eval harness inside your staging environment (Docker) so latency and auth mirrors prod. Alternative: we can run it from Redwood infra and authenticate to your dev endpoint (requires IP allowlist).
2) Baseline run: execute the harness against prompt_set_v1.csv, capture semantic_match, hallucination_score, response_latency, token_cost.
3) Thresholds: initial thresholds we propose: semantic_match >= 0.84, hallucination_score <= 0.06, median latency <= 180ms.
4) Regression alerts: configure alerts for: 
   - Critical regression: >1.5% of requests with semantic_match drop >0.2 vs baseline (24h window)
   - Severe latency: median latency increase >40% vs baseline for 1h
   - Cost drift: token_cost increase >25% vs baseline for 24h
5) Canary policy:
   - Percent: 10% of traffic
   - Observation window: 4 hours
   - Pass criteria: no critical regression, median latency within 20% of baseline, no error spike >0.5%
   - Automatic rollback triggers: critical regression OR error spike >1% OR any severity-high SLA breach

Implementation checklist (minimal):
- [ ] Access to staging endpoint + API key (scoped)
- [ ] Sample dataset (100–200 queries) in CSV
- [ ] Containerized eval harness image: redwood/eval-harness:stable (pull and run)
- [ ] Grafana dashboard link to be created (we’ll share dashboards)
- [ ] PagerDuty integration for critical alerts (optional, recommended)

Quick example command (run from staging host):
$ docker pull redwood/eval-harness:stable
$ docker run --rm -v /data/prompts:/prompts redwood/eval-harness:stable 
  --endpoint https://dev.keenretail.api/rewrite 
  --prompts /prompts/prompt_set_v1.csv 
  --output /prompts/results.json

If you’d like, I can perform the first baseline run during the SE call and share the results live. Proposed SE call slots: Thu 2026-02-12 09:00-09:45 PT or Thu 2026-02-12 13:00-13:45 PT. Which works best?

Thanks,
Dev
